context.host: The host reached by the current authenticated API or native bridge
context.host_change: Remount settings when the authenticated account or host identity changes
context.hook_targets: A project and folder identify where a command executes; they never change the settings context

layout.content: Flat setting rows with a label, optional short description and direct action. Technical setup uses collapsed disclosures.

visuals.colors: Inherit the active app theme; neutral surfaces with existing green focus accent

art.meaning: Standalone symbols for each settings category

flows.technical_setup: Access & sessions > Host connectivity > relevant configuration

interaction.navigation: Arrow keys, Home and End move category focus; Enter selects. Mobile picker uses the same guarded transition.
interaction.drafts: Unsaved edits survive cancelled navigation, failed saves and non-saving preview requests
interaction.writes: A successful save clears only the unchanged draft that produced it
interaction.destructive_actions: Review the exact affected record or host before dispatch
interaction.modal: Trap focus, restore the opener, guard Escape and fit the visual viewport when the keyboard opens
interaction.disclosures: Keep drafts mounted after first opening; defer host setup requests until needed
